Jai Moondra | Player of the Match: [On a memorable performance that helped level the series] Yeah, obviously it's a day I will remember because we need to win to level the series to stay in the fight. So plan was clear to back yourself and just do what you have been doing and bowl the lengths that have been working over here and be disciplined about that and let the results come on. So that's probably was the plan and everyone played through it. So I'm really happy about that. [On making early inroads and putting pressure on the Namibian top order] So main idea was to create pressure and let them create the chances because wicket was favorable for the batsman but if you hit the good length, you can get some nick off and wickets. So that's probably what happened. We wanted to just create the pressure and let's see how things rolls out.

Lorcan Tucker | Ireland captain: [On levelling the series 2-2 with a convincing victory] Yeah, absolutely thrilled. I think we worked really hard for that victory today. A couple of special performances. Jai in the second innings with the new ball, blew Namibia away. It's what we've been asking him to do. It was absolutely amazing and Tim (Tector) in the first innings and Curtis (Campher) putting on that total. I think it really set up the game well for us. [On the positives heading into Sunday's series decider] Like it's set up really nicely. Now 2-2 going into the last game. We've obviously got the advantage today, so we'll try and take that momentum into the last game on Sunday.

A dominant performance with both bat and ball from Ireland has seen them pull off a huge 130-run win to tie the series at 2-2. It all comes down to the final game now! We will be back nice and early to bring you all the action from the decider. Until then, it's goodbye from all of us here!
